architecture_source: Mavenu AI SaaS Platform Development Architecture V4, page 43

design.schema_creation: new empty temporary database bootstrap ONLY; not a migration
design.event_hash_algorithm: sha256 canonical JSON for each case-event and previous hash
design.record_digest_algorithm: sha256 canonical JSON of 10 ordered normalized tables
design.commit_receipt_algorithm: sha256 canonical JSON of batch, source hash, table digest and event-tip
design.idempotency: same batch and exact hashes -> ALREADY_COMMITTED; mismatching batch/source -> reject
design.failure_injection: roll back after copied records or after any synthetic event before single commit

acceptance: One atomic SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction commits all 120 validated synthetic records, 12 events, batch and receipt.
Injected exception after 120 records or within event sequence leaves zero committed rows and no receipt.
Exact retry is idempotent and does not append duplicate records, batches or events.
Altered provenance or mismatched batch digest is rejected, not silently replaced.
Closing and reopening the temporary SQLite database re-verifies foreign keys, checksums, event chain and receipt.
SQL tampering of stored record values is detected by receipt digest even if physical FK constraints remain satisfied.
Append-only triggers block modification or deletion of recorded synthetic events and receipts.
Technical evidence PASS does not grant V23 migration evidence, V24 signoff, actual customer rights, or production persistence.
limitations: V23 reversible migration path is absent in repository; a bootstrap is NOT proof of up/down migrations.
Temporary file-backed SQLite persists only during automated verification and is removed by the TemporaryDirectory context.
SQLite FULL and DELETE journaling tests do not certify power-loss durability, fsync behavior of target production storage or high-availability architecture.
Source and event records are fabricated and not real CMMS, ERP, SCADA, plant, or audited financial data.
Digest chain offers deterministic change detection, not a cryptographic attestation, security boundary or trusted append-only system.
V10/V20 formal phase gates blocked and V21/V22 schema/identity reviews pending.
